scene_properties.Geometry_scope: Complete finite carriage shell, 12 side apertures, 2 true glazed door lights, supported furniture; shared geometry for all cameras.
scene_properties.Scale_status: All dimensions are inferred model units, not measured metres.
scene_properties.PBR_maps: 18 original UV PBR maps at 512x512, plus verified station sign image. Packed and external PNGs.
scene_properties.Exterior: No outside city, adjacent carriage, bogie or exact train make is asserted. Finite outer shell only.
scene_properties.Nominal_dimensions: Model units: inside width ~3.0; length 11.1; central height ~2.6; table 0.795; back ~1.28. Not measured metric dimensions.
scene_properties.Module_count_evidence: At least 5 windows/modules identifiable; 6 used as explicit inference.
scene_properties.Reference_alignment: Precise source fit not achieved. A/B/D parameters are retained for honest comparison, not as proof of source-geometry correctness.
scene_properties.Sign_source: 11:51 THE NEXT STOP IS SHENYUE STATION; static verified wording.
scene_properties.Export_note: 512px maps keep each delivery ZIP below 18 MiB. Original work maps were 1024px.
scene_properties.D_camera_fit: Historical five-landmark camera estimate only. Significant seat-back-top, near-occlusion and overall-depth residuals remain; not accepted as a precise source fit.
scene_properties.Unseen_reverse_end: Inferred matching end closure; no verified 180-degree source view.
scene_properties.Cutaway_policy: Only separate diagnostic cutaway scene may section geometry. All source and interior views use complete unchanged mesh.
scene_properties.Denoising_note: Scene renders without OIDN dependency. Review PNGs may be separately denoised without geometric transforms.
scene_properties.Delivery_status: Completed-space geometry version; precise source fitting NOT ACHIEVED.
scene_properties.Source_fit_status: Candidate; full multi-source fidelity NOT accepted. Sparse camera fit is not full-scene accuracy.
scene_properties.HD_revision: 2026-10-10 candidate; repeated ceiling restored, shared leather updated. No source-specific geometry/light switching.
scene_properties.Inference_limits: Six seat/window bays and unseen reverse closure remain inferred; model units not metres.
scene_properties.HD_r03_material: Normal strength .08; new high-back UV frequency 3x, specular .35. Geometry, camera and global lighting identical to r02.
